requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: I studied mechanical engineering at Limmat Institute of Technology Zurich, where my thesis involved vibration analysis and modal testing for a turbine-blade qualification rig.

requirements.note: Degree is in mechanical engineering rather than electrical engineering, physics, or applied mathematics; whether the stated signal-processing-adjacent thesis work counts as a closely adjacent field or demonstrated equivalent is a judgement call for the recruiter.

lines.quote: I have some familiarity with Kalman filtering and estimation theory
I have taken on team coordination and leadership responsibilities beyond my formal title.
EU citizen (Croatian passport), unrestricted right to work in Finland.
All documentation produced in English as the company working language.

my partner and I have already started looking at housing in Oulu. We have family connections in northern Finland and the relocation is something we are actively planning regardless of this particular role.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware under timing constraints, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing Python to production or engineering standards, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench or measurement experience you have, if any?
